PHYSICAL EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

   C. Refuse all feedback on High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique.
   D. Practise High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
